header.title: Analytics
header.subtitle: Analytical cookies are used to understand how visitors interact with the website. These cookies help provide information on metrics such as the number of visitors, bounce rate, traffic source, etc.

mainHeader.title: This website uses Cookies.
mainHeader.subtitle: We have put some small files called cookies on your device to make our website work and to improve your user experience. As a result, we may collect and process your site usage data. Let us know what cookies you allow. We will use a cookie to save your choice. Before making your choice, you can read more about our Cookie Policy.

consentPreferenceHeader.title: Customize Consent Preferences
consentPreferenceHeader.subtitle: By clicking on the “Save & Close” button, you consent to store on your device all the enabled cookies as described in our Cookie Policy for us to access and process your personal data collected. You can read more on how we process your personal data by visiting our Website Privacy Notice.

necessaryCookie.title: Strictly necessary/ Essential cookies
necessaryCookie.subtitle: Necessary cookies are required to enable the basic features of this site, such as providing secure log-in or adjusting your consent preferences. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable data.
